Highly recommended and delicious
Oct 2026 • Couples
My husband and I were looking for an Indian restaurant as we felt like a curry for lunch and we came across Baba’s Kitchen in Saigon. The restaurant was clean and well presented, the service impeccable and the food wow amazingly delicious. We enjoyed pappadam, vegetable samosas, roti, chicken korma with rice followed by a light rice cream dessert on the house which was so refreshing. Thank you for the delicious food, highly recommended!!

reviews.review_text:
shanah08
Singapore26 contributions
0
Halal food at home Chi Minh - South Indian food
Dec 2025 • Family
Our first time there and we simply love the ambience and food! Southern Indian cuisine - Tosei(dosa) masala really hits the nail! Crispy on the outside and soft and tasty on the inside .. very generous on the gravies .. the tea was fabulous too.. next on the menu we had chicken , prawn and mutton bryani.. all wonderful and satisfied our taste buds .. again the portion was pretty generous and serve in traditional Indian pot . The staff Mr Tu was very attentive to our needs and knowing that we love to have gravies for our bryani , he had given us complimentary curry each . We can never had enough .. place is wheelchair friendly, halal and peaceful to have lunch .. thank you Baba’s restaurant for making our tummies happy!
